description: Source code for a MAC Protocol Data Unit (PDU) assembler in a 4G/5G radio communication system, including functions for encoding SDUs, handling MAC headers, and assembling PDUs for downlink transmission.

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu::mac_sdu_encoder
classes.description: Handles encoding of SDUs within a MAC PDU, including subheader management and buffer operations.

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu
classes.description: Represents a downlink MAC PDU with methods to add SDUs, control elements, and encode subheaders.

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler
classes.description: Responsible for assembling downlink PDUs, including SDU collection, padding, and logging.

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler::pdu_log_builder
classes.description: Utility class for logging details of the PDU assembly process.

methods.name: min_mac_subhdr_and_sdu_space_required
methods.description: Calculates the minimum space needed for MAC subheader and SDU based on logical channel ID.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::mac_sdu_encoder::sdu_buffer
methods.description: Returns a buffer span for the SDU payload within the PDU.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::mac_sdu_encoder::encode_sdu
methods.description: Encodes an SDU into the PDU, managing subheader size and buffer shifts.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::get_sdu_encoder
methods.description: Creates and returns a MAC SDU encoder for a given logical channel ID and estimated size.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::add_sdu
methods.description: Adds an SDU to the PDU from a span of bytes.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::add_sdu (overload)
methods.description: Adds an SDU to the PDU from a byte_buffer object.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::add_ue_con_res_id
methods.description: Adds a UE connection resource ID element to the PDU.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::add_tag_cmd
methods.description: Adds a Timing Advance command element to the PDU.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::add_padding
methods.description: Adds padding bytes to the PDU.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu::encode_subheader
methods.description: Encodes a MAC subheader with specified parameters into the PDU buffer.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler::assemble_newtx_pdu
methods.description: Assembles a new downlink transmission PDU, including SDUs and control elements.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler::assemble_sdus
methods.description: Encodes SDUs for a specific logical channel into the PDU.

methods.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler::assemble_ce
methods.description: Encodes control elements into the PDU.
